title: Microsoft 365 Apps admin center: Cloud Update and Inventory export improvements
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned export improvements from the Inventory export behaviour Microsoft currently documents. The roadmap details, export path, licensing prerequisites and role requirements are supported; the reference to cloud update auditing needs its Microsoft source added.
